**Chapter Title:**
Chapter 29 Motor Control PWM (MCPWM)

**Register Information:**
- Register Name: INT_RAW_PWM_REG (0x0114)
- Description of the register in hexadecimal format.

**Interrupt Status Bits Table:**

| Interrupt | Raw Status Bit |
|------------|----------------|
| INT_CAP2_INT_RAW | The raw status bit for the interrupt triggered by capture on channel 2. (RO) |
| INT_CAP1_INT_RAW | The raw status bit for the interrupt triggered by capture on channel 1. (RO) |
| INTCAPE0_INT_RAW | The raw status bit for the interrupt triggered by capture on channel 0. (RO) |
| INTFH2_OST_INT_RAW | The raw status bit for the interrupt triggered by a one-shot mode action on PWM2. (RO) |
| INTFH1_OST_INT_RAW | The raw status bit for the interrupt triggered by a one-shot mode action on PWM0. (RO) |
| INTFHOcast_INT_RAW | The raw status bit for the interrupt triggered by a cycle-by-cycle mode action on PWM2. (RO) |
| INTFH1_CBC_INT_RAW | The raw status bit for the interrupt triggered by a cycle-by-cycle mode action on PWM1. (RO) |
| INTFHO_CBC_INT_RAW | The raw status bit for the interrupt triggered by a cycle-by-cycle mode action on PWM0. (RO) |
| INTOP2_TEB_INT_RAW | The raw status bit for the interrupt triggered by a PWM operator 2 TEB event. (RO) |
| INTOP1_TEB_INT_RAW | The raw status bit for the interrupt triggered by a PWM operator 1 TEB event. (RO) |
| INOTOPEcast_INT_RAW | The raw status bit for the interrupt triggered by a PWM operator 0 TEB event. (RO) |
| INTOP2_TEAcaast_INT_RAW | The raw status bit for the interrupt triggered by a PWM operator 2 TEA event. (RO) |
|
